name: inbrowse
description: A fast headless browser for Claude Code: pages with JavaScript, forms and tabs; PDF, Office and spreadsheet text; video frames, audio and captions; OCR; research posts from Reddit, X, Hacker News, GitHub and Polymarket

inbrowse_path.title: Inbrowse binary
inbrowse_path.description: The inbrowse executable, version 0.3.0 or later. The default, inbrowse, means it is on your PATH.

ocr_url.title: OCR engine address
ocr_url.description: The Incord memory engine that reads text in images. Watchman runs it at this address.

ocr_key.title: OCR engine key
ocr_key.description: Key for the OCR engine, only if it asks for one. Stored in the system's secure storage.

route_webfetch.title: Read WebFetch through Inbrowse
route_webfetch.description: Answer Claude Code's WebFetch with the page as Inbrowse renders it, JavaScript run, in a tab of its own. Off: WebFetch works as built in.

prefer_inbrowse.title: Tell the model to prefer Inbrowse
prefer_inbrowse.description: Add a short system-prompt section naming the Inbrowse tools for pages, documents, media, images and research sources.
